chunks: For them will be fruits and whatever they ask.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific rewards mentioned for the inhabitants of Paradise in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to signify that the inhabitants of Paradise will possess not only the natural fruits of the earth but also the specific desires (da'wa) they cherished in life, reflecting divine generosity. It underscores the concept of 'faikahat' (fruits) as a symbol of sustenance and pleasure, while 'ma yadda'oon' (what they call for) highlights the fulfillment of both material and spiritual aspirations without limitation.
